<observation>Reviewed the screenshot as a QA reviewer for visual defects. All text is legible and fully visible, no truncation or compression. Components are aligned and proportionally sized without stretching or skewing. No overlapping elements obscure content or controls. The red mug image matches its context as a product placeholder; no semantic conflict. Bar chart percentages (80% note, 20% mug) visually correspond to bar lengths — no numeric vs. graphic mismatch. No evidence of occlusion, geometry distortion, readability loss, image-meaning conflict, or chart-meaning discrepancy. Design appears intentional with clean layout and readable Korean text.</observation>
